selection_rule: All10 census metrics with any pre-existing binding plus STR15/STR19/PRED-B1 controls, selected before reading census labels or rankings; not result-selected.

final_answer_rubric.requirement: Preserve already computed value, units, count, cutoff and window; do not recompute, invent missing observations or conceal uncertain/data status.
Substantive scientific explanation must follow the supplied original source evidence, current claim scope and limitations; do not turn a source-reported or estimated value into physiological truth.
Do not infer personal cause, disease, muscle recovery, hypertrophy, physiological plateau, calibrated prediction or individual treatment effect without specific authority.
No invented weights, thresholds, percentages, RIR, complete plan or candidate permissions; a group result or general principle cannot become a personal numeric prescription.
When the frozen task policy or deterministic capability denies source explanation, explicitly preserve insufficient evidence and confine output to computed descriptive facts.
Respect exact source/version and protocol boundaries, including 2021 author preprint versus published work; no claim of expert or personal validation.
Any unavailable model or degraded retrieval must remain visible; offline/template output is not a successful full hybrid or AI semantic explanation.

source_explanation_expectations: Frozen census task judgments, not actual ranking outcomes. Deterministic capability and missing-calibration constraints remain authoritative.
